title: Menu Card
prompt: Print a three-line menu exactly: 1. Start / 2. Settings / 3. Quit — one print call, using \n escapes or a triple-quoted string.

tests.name: prints menu in one call
tests.code:
assert printed == ["1. Start", "2. Settings", "3. Quit"], f"got {printed}"
assert code.count("print(") == 1, "use exactly ONE print call"
